draw: the sealed order of key oext.phtest (no parts) over all candidate IDs, sorted as strings; walking it, an eligible ID whose normalized prompt equals an earlier taken one is skipped and counted (duplicate_within_phtest); the first bank_size taken form the bank
filter_rule: each filter runs on the previous filter's survivors; a row counts under every reason of its filter and is removed once
filters: 1 exact duplicates of a normalized prompt: overlap_with_an_existing_or_evaluation_prompt (P's training, query and evaluation forms, every bank and split), overlap_with_an_anchor_prompt, overlap_with_an_s_pool_prompt, overlap_with_a_plant_prompt

2 near duplicates (character 5-gram Jaccard >= max_jaccard): near_duplicate_of_evaluation_prompt_<bank> (dev, selector, hidden), near_duplicate_of_an_anchor_prompt, near_duplicate_of_an_s_pool_prompt, near_duplicate_of_a_plant_prompt
4 generation_prompt_<error>: encode_generation_prompt refuses under REC's model.max_prompt_tokens

inputs.plant: REQ-8's plant_rows.json (the 75 plant rows), by SHA-256 on the command line
inputs.s_pool: REQ-6's s_pool.json, by SHA-256 on the command line

name: build_oext

outputs.full: --full-out, inside a folder named tmp: oext_bank.json (ids and prompts, in the sealed order)
outputs.record: --out: oext_record.json (text-free: ids, prompt SHA-256s, counts by reason, the input hashes)

phtest.never: the controversial rows (1,192) are never used; nothing is downloaded

requirement: lead decisions section 7 (the O-ext draw; REQ-19 fired, O MDE 11.04 pp); UW-07a; part of REQ-6's batch
shortfall_rule: LN-24 (addendum section 10): after that stop, the lead runs the build again with --accept-shortfall and the bank is all N' eligible prompts (the primary O bank is then the dev 100 plus N'), fixed and recorded before any stage-1 O answer is read; N' = 0 refuses (fallback F: the dev 100 only)
stop: fewer than bank_size taken: stop with counts only; nothing written (addendum section 7.3)
use: the primary O bank is the dev 100 plus these 400 (UW-07a), judged on answers capped at 128 tokens after W1-18's check; per-source reports keep the two sources apart
